title_en: Rescue emergency system and method for unmanned aerial vehicle and robot dog
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence rescue and discloses a rescue emergency system and a rescue emergency method for unmanned aerial vehicles and machine dogs, wherein the rescue emergency system for the unmanned aerial vehicles and the machine dogs comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module, a wireless communication module and a wireless communication module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster module is used for acquiring aerial data, guaranteeing communication and delivering emergency materials; the system comprises a ground environment detection module, a machine dog cluster module, a communication coordination module, a central control module, a man-machine interaction interface module and a control module, wherein the machine dog cluster module is used for ground environment detection, sample collection and special task execution, the communication coordination module is used for ensuring information intercommunication and task coordination between space and ground equipment, the central control module is used for providing task instructions for unmanned aerial vehicle clusters and machine dog clusters, the man-machine interaction interface module is used for realizing effective communication between rescue personnel and a system, and the modules are used for cooperatively working to realize multi-source data collection, three-dimensional scene reconstruction, semantic segmentation, risk assessment, fire spread prediction and decision support information generation on disaster sites and provide reliable basis for rescue command decisions.

title_en: Knowledge-graph-based construction method for emergency rescue channel path of heavy super forest fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an emergency rescue channel path of a heavy extra forest fire based on a knowledge graph, which belongs to the field of forest fire rescue and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and standardization processing, S2, forest fire dynamic risk assessment, S3, knowledge graph entity extraction, S4, emergency rescue channel path construction, and S5, emergency rescue channel path feasibility scoring calculation. By adopting the knowledge-graph-based construction method for the path of the emergency rescue channel of the severe forest fire, the breakthrough of the path of the emergency rescue channel from static planning to dynamic adaptation is realized by coupling the multi-mode data semantic association with real-time risk, combining the collaborative exploration of the unmanned aerial vehicle group with path planning, and combining the fire spread simulation with knowledge graph reasoning, so that the rescue efficiency of the severe forest fire is remarkably improved.

title_en: Mountain expressway emergency rescue path planning method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a mountain expressway emergency rescue path planning method and system, which are characterized by collecting traffic flow data, meteorological data and on-site state data of disaster places, generating a dynamic risk map according to the meteorological data, the on-site state data and the traffic flow data, determining rescue constraint conditions of each rescue body in an emergency rescue process according to dynamic position information of rescue bodies near the disaster places and rescue body types of the rescue bodies, carrying out hierarchical scheduling on each rescue body based on the dynamic risk map and all the rescue constraint conditions to obtain a space-time conflict matrix, and carrying out multi-objective real-time path planning on each rescue body according to the space-time conflict matrix to generate a space-time conflict-free collaborative rescue path set. By adopting the scheme of the application, the high-efficiency cooperation of multiple rescue bodies can be realized under the multi-disaster chain coupling evolution environment of the expressway in the mountain area so as to generate a space-time conflict-free global optimal rescue path.

title_en: Intelligent escape evacuation indication system of hydropower station and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape evacuation, in particular to an intelligent escape evacuation indicating system of a hydropower station and a control method thereof, comprising the steps of collecting three-dimensional space data and real-time operation parameters of the hydropower station, and establishing a digital twin model of the hydropower station environment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out risk assessment on a digital twin model to obtain a risk assessment matrix, optimizing an evacuation strategy of an action set according to a Q-learning algorithm to obtain an evacuation path planning table, embedding emergency constraint conditions into the evacuation path planning table, verifying path feasibility according to a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, carrying out path reconstruction on a region with equipment blockage or structural damage, calculating the shortest safety distance of an alternative path according to the Dijkstra algorithm to obtain an optimized evacuation scheme, and carrying out noise suppression on a prediction result to obtain an evacuation instruction set. According to the invention, the Monte Carlo tree search and Dijkstra algorithm are used for rescheduling the alternative path, so that personnel can find the safest evacuation route, and the strain capacity of the system under complex and sudden conditions is improved.

title_en: The unmanned air vehicle for castaway tracking
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned air vehicle comprising: a body; a camera for photographing the front; a microphone for receiving an external sound; a speaker capable of delivering sound to the outside; a directional antenna oriented in a moving direction; a proximity sensor for detecting an obstacle; an environmental sensor for sensing a surrounding environmental condition; and a steering antenna for transmitting control information. By inputting the unmanned air vehicle into various disaster sites such as a fire site or a collapse site to rescue a castaway, the unmanned air vehicle can rapidly find a castaway without inputting manpower into a high-risk site, thereby providing a safe route where a rescue team can enter.

title_en: Heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire rescue cooperative scheduling method based on reinforcement learning and quantum particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire rescue cooperative scheduling method based on reinforcement learning and quantum particle swarm optimization, which relates to the field of cooperative scheduling and comprises the steps of constructing a cellular automaton fire spread model based on wind speed, vegetation and gradient and generating a combustion cell priority sequence; the method comprises the steps of establishing a three-state conversion model of the multi-type unmanned aerial vehicle, combining combustion loss and flight time to construct comprehensive cost, realizing task allocation and flight path solving through a reinforced learning enhanced quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm, adopting a rolling update mechanism to correct a scheduling scheme in real time and triggering fault tolerance rescheduling under abnormal conditions, and improving collaborative fire extinguishing efficiency of heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle swarms.

title_en: Fire scene fire monitoring method and system based on three-dimensional laser scanning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene fire monitoring method and a fire scene fire monitoring system based on a three-dimensional laser scanning technology, which relate to the technical field of fire monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting a fire scene structure diagram for path planning, and deploying sensors on a robot for real-time path navigation and obstacle avoidance; and after reaching the target point, carrying out three-dimensional laser scanning, collecting data, processing the collected data and carrying out three-dimensional modeling. According to the invention, by combining a three-dimensional laser scanning technology and a robot intelligent navigation system and utilizing a high-precision three-dimensional point cloud data and sensor fusion technology, comprehensive monitoring of a fire scene is realized, data can be dynamically collected and three-dimensional modeling can be carried out on the fire scene through autonomous path planning and obstacle avoidance of the robot, heat source distribution and smoke diffusion tracks are analyzed, a fire spreading path is further predicted, a real-time updated three-dimensional fire scene map is generated, high-efficiency accurate fire information can be provided in a complex environment, and important basis is provided for decision support and emergency rescue of the fire scene.

title_en: Converged communication intelligent scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of converged communication, and particularly discloses a converged communication intelligent scheduling system which comprises a target fire scene image acquisition module, a fire spreading risk analysis module, a firefighter position information analysis module, a monitoring picture quality evaluation module, a communication link state monitoring module and a converged communication scheduling decision module; the method comprises the steps of calculating risk coefficients based on image features and meteorological data to generate a first scheduling instruction, and calculating a concentration density coefficient according to firefighter position information to generate a second scheduling instruction; adaptively adjusting a communication link based on an image quality evaluation result, performing intelligent scheduling optimization based on a stability evaluation result of the communication link, integrating a first scheduling instruction and a second scheduling instruction, and executing communication resource allocation adjustment; by introducing the fusion communication technology, the invention realizes the instant transmission and efficient integration of information, provides accurate decision support for commanders, and integrally improves the efficiency and success rate of fire rescue.
assignees: SHANGHAI TIANXIANTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-navigation route planning method and system based on fire rescue virtual reality scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-navigation route planning method and system based on a fire rescue virtual reality scene, wherein the method and system comprise the steps of receiving environmental data of a forest fire area in real time through a Beidou navigation signal transceiver mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle, calculating fire spread data according to the environmental data by a calculation node configured by the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a prediction virtual environment of the forest fire area through VR imaging equipment mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the fire spread data, dividing a exploration point working area of the forest fire area based on the prediction virtual environment of the forest fire area, planning a non-navigation route of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to real-time coordinates and the divided exploration point working area of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and selecting an optimal route according to a distribution weight algorithm. According to the method, the influence of environmental factors is fully considered, the modeling accuracy of the virtual environment is improved, the objectivity of interest point selection is increased, the planned unmanned aerial vehicle non-navigation route is more scientific and reasonable, and the exploration effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle is greatly improved.

title_en: High-intelligent disaster field environment pre-exploration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-intelligent disaster field environment pre-exploration system which comprises a plurality of high-intelligent robots and a remote control terminal connected with the high-intelligent robots in a remote mode, wherein each high-intelligent robot comprises a motion control module, a risk assessment module, a first communication module, a positioning module and an environment sensing module, and the remote control terminal comprises a path planning module, an instruction generation module, a second communication module and a map mapping module. According to the technical scheme, the special sensor module equipped with the high-intelligent robot can be relied on, the exploration route is allocated through the remote control terminal, the method can adapt to multiple application scenes such as fire disaster, chemical leakage and nuclear leakage, the disaster field environment is divided into the low-risk area, the medium-risk area and the high-risk area according to exploration sampling data and preset indexes and is presented in the form of a disaster field risk map, so that the traversing preliminary exploration of the disaster field environment is realized, and corresponding safety guarantee references are provided for the entering of follow-up professional disaster rescue personnel.

title_en: Intelligent fire scene fire rescue system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire scene fire rescue system and a control method, which are characterized in that fire source distribution is positioned by acquiring fire fighter state data and temperature change information and utilizing a gradient analysis reverse tracking technology, fire spread prediction is carried out based on the fire source distribution data, an evacuation path scheme from danger to a safe area is constructed, a safe operation range is formulated, a rescue target is subjected to task disassembly to generate a fragmented task set, a task allocation scheme is dynamically recombined based on the fire fighter state, a two-way state confirmation channel of a rescuer and a rescuee is established, rescue effect evaluation and failure risk analysis are carried out, task combination is optimized, monitoring and abnormal mode recognition are carried out in the rescue process, safety evaluation is carried out in combination with the evacuation path scheme, the rescue target is adjusted according to a safety state monitoring result, risk conversion is carried out to generate controllable risk parameters, and a rescue strategy is formulated, so that intelligent safety rescue with 'first guarantee of exiting and then maximized rescue effect' is realized.

title_en: Fire control dispatch management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control scheduling management system which comprises an environment sensing and monitoring module, a fire spreading prediction and assessment module, an intelligent scheduling and decision support module, a real-time navigation and path planning module and an intelligent scheduling and decision support module, wherein the environment sensing and monitoring module is responsible for collecting fire scene and external environment data thereof in real time, the fire spreading prediction and assessment module is responsible for assessing and predicting a spreading trend of a fire based on the collected data, the intelligent scheduling and decision support module is responsible for dynamically adjusting a resource allocation scheme according to the latest fire spreading trend, the real-time navigation and path planning module is responsible for providing real-time navigation and path planning service for firefighters according to the resource allocation scheme, and the intelligent scheduling and decision support module can change the fire spreading trend and the variability of external environment in real time so as to realize optimal scheduling of firefighters, fire equipment and other resources. The dynamic adjustment mechanism avoids the limitation that the traditional manual scheduling cannot cope with sudden changes, and ensures that resources can be put into the most needed places according to the optimal path and the most effective mode.

title_en: High-intelligence disaster field environment pre-exploration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highly intelligent disaster field environment pre-exploration system which comprises a plurality of highly intelligent robots and a remote control terminal remotely connected with the highly intelligent robots, wherein each highly intelligent robot comprises a motion control module, a risk assessment module, a first communication module, a positioning module and an environment sensing module, and the remote control terminal comprises a path planning module, an instruction generation module, a second communication module and a map mapping module. According to the technical scheme, the exploration route can be allocated through the remote control terminal by depending on a special sensor module arranged by a high-intelligent robot, so that the system can adapt to multiple application scenes such as fire, chemical leakage and nuclear leakage, a disaster field environment is divided into a low-risk area, a medium-risk area and a high-risk area according to exploration sampling data and preset indexes and presented in the form of a disaster field risk map, traversal preliminary exploration for the disaster field environment is realized, and corresponding safety guarantee reference is provided for the entry of subsequent professional disaster relief workers.

title_en: Digital twinning-based regional fire risk dynamic assessment method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of risk assessment, and provides a digital twinning-based regional fire risk dynamic assessment method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring regional data of a target region through an intelligent sensor, carrying out data fusion based on data sources corresponding to the regional data to generate a space-time continuous data field, generating a fire spreading probability field and a heat release rate field based on the data field, the topographic data and vegetation distribution in the target region, generating a fire control resource utility function based on the fire spreading probability field and the acquired fire control resource distribution, generating a fire development utility function based on the fire spreading probability field and the heat release rate field, carrying out path planning according to the difference value between the fire control resource utility function and the fire development utility function, and generating a rescue path and a resource allocation scheme. By dynamically planning the optimal rescue path and the resource allocation scheme, accurate assessment of fire risks and efficient allocation of rescue resources are achieved, and the efficiency of fire emergency response is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING CHANGYI FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Path planning method and apparatus and electronic device
abstract_en: A path planning method and apparatus and an electronic device, relating to the technical field of data processing. The path planning method comprises: acquiring a local three-dimensional model corresponding to a forest fire spreading region in a forest region to be subjected to firefighting, wherein the local three-dimensional model is used for indicating the spatial position of the forest fire spreading region (101); acquiring a configuration space of firefighters in said forest region, wherein the configuration space is used for indicating the movable positions and/or movable directions of the firefighters (102); determining a target manifold space according to the configuration space and the local three-dimensional model (103); and performing path search in the target manifold space to obtain a target planned path between an initial point (q I ) and a target point (q G ) for travelling of the firefighters (104).
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Path planning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a path planning method, a path planning device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a local three-dimensional model corresponding to a forest fire spreading area in a forest area to be extinguished; the local three-dimensional model is used for indicating the spatial position of the forest fire spreading area; acquiring a configuration space of a fire fighter in a forest area to be extinguished, wherein the configuration space is used for indicating the movable position and/or movable direction of the fire fighter; determining a target manifold space according to the position space and the local three-dimensional model; and searching a path from the target manifold space to obtain a target planning path between a starting point of the travel of the fire fighter and the target point. Therefore, the method can realize that in a forest fire scene, a travel path to an appointed target point is planned for a fire fighter, namely, the path is reasonably planned for the fire fighter in the process of executing a forest fire extinguishing task, so that the fire scene threat is avoided, and the fire extinguishing efficiency is improved.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Path planning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a path planning method, a path planning device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a local three-dimensional model corresponding to a forest fire spreading area in a forest area to be extinguished, wherein the local three-dimensional model is used for indicating the space position of the forest fire spreading area, obtaining a configuration space of fire extinguishing personnel in the forest area to be extinguished, wherein the configuration space is used for indicating the movable position and/or the movable direction of the fire extinguishing personnel, determining a target manifold space according to the configuration space and the local three-dimensional model, and carrying out path search from the target manifold space to obtain a target planning path between a starting point of travel of the fire extinguishing personnel and a target point. Therefore, the method can realize that in a forest fire scene, a travel path to an appointed target point is planned for a fire fighter, namely, the path is reasonably planned for the fire fighter in the process of executing a forest fire extinguishing task, so that the fire scene threat is avoided, and the fire extinguishing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Coal mine belt fire disaster avoidance path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine belt fire disaster avoidance path planning method and system. The method comprises the steps of performing informatization management on combustion attributes of ignition objects of the underground belt roadway, and establishing a fine mine roadway three-dimensional model; constructing the equivalent length of the roadway under the influence of a fire escape static factor according to the static attribute of the mine roadway; carrying out numerical simulation on the typical working conditions of the managed ignition points to obtain a fire spreading rule, and constructing key index time characteristics of reaching each roadway when the fire spreading occurs under different working conditions of different fire source sites; the fire source working condition case with the highest similarity is searched from the numerical simulation case by a case rechecking method, the time of a fire disaster reaching each roadway and the influence degree of the roadway are predicted by combining real-time monitoring data and simulation data, the equivalent length of each node roadway is dynamically calculated, and the escape data of personnel are dynamically planned by adopting a Di Jie St-Lag algorithm, so that a dynamically planned disaster avoidance route is obtained. The scheme improves the accuracy of the fire disaster avoidance path and the real-time performance of the on-site response.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Integrated and separated type multi-unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system based on urban fire spread prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized-distributed multi-unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system based on urban fire spread prediction, which comprises the following components: a central layer unmanned plane and a plurality of isomorphic execution layer unmanned planes; the central layer unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first sensor module for collecting initial environment and trapped personnel information, a first environment analysis module for analyzing and processing the environment information and a first communication module for communicating with the execution layer unmanned aerial vehicle; any of the execution layer unmanned aerial vehicles comprises a second sensor module for collecting real-time environment information, a second environment analysis module, a second communication module for communicating with the central layer unmanned aerial vehicle and other unmanned aerial vehicles of the execution layer, a decision module for carrying out path planning according to an environment model and the positions of trapped people, a control module for controlling the execution layer unmanned aerial vehicle to travel according to the planned path, and an execution module for guiding the trapped people to avoid danger. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle guides rescue, so that the safety hazard of fire to firefighters can be reduced.
